meta.title: Newlywed Diary
meta.description: A life sim from marriage to retirement, driven only by choices: buy or skip, high, mid or low.

title.lead:
From marriage to retirement,
a life sim made only of choices
title.prequel: Play the prequel, Solo Living Diary

setup.heading: Setup
setup.incomeHint: Default incomes are the median for that age.
setup.handoff: Continuing from Solo Living Diary. Your gender, age at marriage, income and car carry over from that game's result.
setup.handoffSavings: Savings carried over: {savings:money} (added to your partner's savings)
setup.handoffCar: Car: the one you drove in Solo Living Diary (worth {value:money})

main.resumed: Picked up where we left off.

childPlan.title: Children

workStyle.title: Rethinking work
workStyle.singleNote: Returning to work, income drops for each year away

university.text: {child} is graduating from high school. Go to university?
university.noSub: Moves out at 18. More likely to send money home

house.text: Buy a home? {down}% down (or whatever savings allow), the rest on a {years}-year mortgage at {rate}%. If not, you'll rent a larger family place ({rent:money}/yr).
